text:
Man's best friend is the dog.

In the provided text, the clock is personified as a "stern schoolmaster," a metaphor that transforms an inanimate object into an authoritative figure of discipline and control. This symbolism suggests that time is not merely passing but is actively enforcing rules and order upon the students. The phrase "temporal grip" further reinforces this imagery, depicting time as a physical constraint or prison, emphasizing the students' lack of autonomy and the oppressive nature of the academic environment.
